name: Wooden Winter House
description: A single-storey minecraft house in dark wood with a wraparound porch and three gabled roofs. Beds sit out on the deck and a fenced walkway rings the whole build. Almost all spruce, so one tree farm covers it. A solid main base for a taiga or snowy survival world.
